reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/cmdbuf.rs owns a static 2048-byte command array, separately allocated history nodes/strings and completion text. cp is an interior cursor into the static array, never a heap owner.
owner_creation.invariant: Static editing bytes and heap history/completion need separate owner rules.
limitations: The command array cannot be reallocated or passed to free.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/cmdbuf.rs cmd_ichar moves text through raw cp-relative aliases, and history list cursors borrow linked nodes. Deduplication frees matching node/string pairs after unlinking them.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Cursor and list aliases must remain valid through the editing operation.
limitations: Stable command-array address does not preserve text or history-node lifetime.

callback_targets.analysis: src/cmdbuf.rs save_cmdhist passes copy_hist and a stack save_ctx to read_cmdhist; copy_hist casts uparam back to that context and writes the selected stream/list synchronously.
callback_targets.invariant: The context borrow must end before save_cmdhist returns.
limitations: This is a callback scope analysis, not new independent callback execution.

invalidation.analysis: src/cmdbuf.rs cmd_reset resets cursor, terminator and editing scalars in place; set_tk_original separately frees and replaces heap completion text. These invalidate text and completion aliases without moving cmdbuf.
invalidation.invariant: A reset text borrow and a freed completion pointer are different invalidations.
limitations: The reallocation limitation in the prior scalar packet is corrected separately.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/cmdbuf.rs insertion checks capacity before shifting suffix/terminator; history save creates an exclusive temp stream and commits only after stream status, fclose and rename succeed.
mutation_commit.invariant: Command bounds and history publication have independent commit boundaries.
limitations: Current history repairs do not close the still-open M0-HIST-001 record.

release_pair.analysis: src/cmdbuf.rs dedup frees owned history strings/nodes; history save closes its stream and frees temp/destination paths. None of those releases applies to the static command array or cp.
release_pair.invariant: Never apply a heap release to cmdbuf or its interior cursor.
limitations: History nodes retained in global lists have a different lifetime from temporary paths.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/cmdbuf.rs failed fdopen closes the acquired FD and unlinks its temp path; failed stream/close/rename restores dirty entries and diagnoses, preserving the prior destination on unsuccessful commit.
error_cleanup.invariant: An unsuccessful save must preserve dirty-state retry information.
limitations: Fatal allocation before these checked branches is not covered by a universal RAII guard.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/cmdbuf.rs temporarily forces insert_mode for cmd_istr and later restores it, while raw globals encode no exclusive editor entry. M0-MEM-001 remains open; no handler-to-editor mutation trace is asserted.
signals_handoff.invariant: Ordinary editor access must preserve one coherent cursor/mode state.
limitations: Reentrant editing is an unproved precondition concern, not a demonstrated signal path.
